card.name: Scripture verse and section numbers
card.fires_on: The last digit or next word right after a chapter:verse or section citation, such as the 4 in John 1:14 or the word after Heb. 6:20. It also appears at the end of a number or ordinal like Four-teenth.

modes.label: Verse number digits
modes.description: The final digit or a following comma/word in a Bible or Koran verse reference.

modes.label: Other numbered references
modes.description: Last part of a section, sequence, or ordinal number in legal or technical text.

modes.label: Verb or noun after a citation
modes.description: The word that follows a scripture reference or table mention, starting a sentence about it.
modes.example: Koran 1:2<< is>> a reference to the Koran
